aboutText: Designs by Brooke is an emerging fashion portfolio exploring the relationship between fabric, silhouette, color, and personal style. The work focuses on material choices, texture combinations, soft neutral palettes, styling ideas, and visual storytelling.
portfolioIntro: This portfolio will showcase material studies, texture boards, fashion sketches, styling concepts, garment details, and finished creative projects.
